title: A Local Sinkhorn Framework for Conditional Distribution Reconstruction of Multidimensional Random Fields
abstract: arXiv:2608.11613v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In this paper, we propose a local Sinkhorn divergence framework for conditional distribution reconstruction of multidimensional random fields. By utilizing the debiased Sinkhorn divergence, our proposed approach develops a differentiable and computationally efficient local distribution matching objective to train stochastic neural networks (SNNs). Furthermore, we establish theoretical generalization error estimates for our local Sinkhorn divergence framework, which explicitly characterizes the trade-off between approximation bias and statistical efficiency controlled by the regularization parameter and reveals how our proposed local Sinkhorn divergence loss function can be efficiently applied to learning multidimensional random field models. translated_title: 多维随机场条件分布重建的局部Sinkhorn框架
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种用于多维随机场条件分布重建的局部Sinkhorn散度框架。通过利用去偏的Sinkhorn散度，我们提出的方法开发了一个可微且计算高效的局部分布匹配目标，用于训练随机神经网络（SNN）。此外，我们为局部Sinkhorn散度框架建立了理论泛化误差估计，该估计明确刻画了由正则化参数控制的近似偏差与统计效率之间的权衡，并揭示了所提出的局部Sinkhorn散度损失函数如何有效应用于学习多维随机场模型。该框架为条件分布重建提供了精确局部最优传输的可扩展替代方案，在几何保真度、统计效率和计算实用性之间取得了实际折中。
tldr: 提出了一种基于局部Sinkhorn散度的可扩展框架，用于高效训练随机神经网络以重建多维随机场的条件分布，并提供了理论泛化误差分析。
en_tdlr: A scalable local Sinkhorn divergence framework is proposed for efficiently training stochastic neural networks to reconstruct conditional distributions of multidimensional random fields, with theoretical generalization error guarantees.
